name: Racknap the Slate Cat
blurb: Racknap, a plush slate-grey cat with green eyes that glow like little status lights, naps on the warmest stone in the garden.

name: Cabletail the Silver Tabby Cat
blurb: Cabletail, a lean silver tabby whose fine blue-grey stripes run like bundled cables, threads through the flower beds and never gets tangled.

name: Allnight the Tuxedo Cat
blurb: Allnight, a tuxedo cat with a white chest and white paws, keeps watch over the sleeping garden from dusk to dawn and never switches off.
